recent_events.title: Optima Bank earned 2.56 billion KGS in 2025 — all profit retained
recent_events.description: At the annual general meeting, shareholders unanimously voted to retain the entire 2.56 bln KGS net profit as undistributed, forgoing dividends in favour of business development, regulatory compliance and resilience. Nurlan Tokobaev was elected as a new independent director (4-year term).
recent_events.impact: Capital base strengthened; signals confidence from the new Kaspi-linked shareholder.

recent_events.title: Kaspi co-founder Vyacheslav Kim completed largest-ever bank recapitalisation in Kyrgyzstan
recent_events.description: Vyacheslav Kim injected 3.4 bln KGS into Optima Bank — more than tripling the previous 2023 increase and lifting the bank's capital by 2.6×. The injection was voluntary, not regulator-driven, and drove 89% of the entire 2025 foreign-capital growth in Kyrgyzstan's banking sector.
recent_events.impact: Optima Bank capital strengthened to support aggressive growth; ownership consolidated under Kaspi.kz ecosystem.

recent_events.title: Optima Bank concluded '20 Millionaires' promotion
recent_events.description: Six-month promotional campaign (17 Nov 2025 – 12 Apr 2026) selected 20 winners via algorithmic weekly draws, creating 20 new millionaires.
recent_events.impact: Reinforced retail deposit growth and brand visibility.

recent_events.title: NBKR granted Optima Bank Islamic finance license
recent_events.description: The National Bank of Kyrgyzstan licensed Optima Bank to operate an Islamic finance window in both national and foreign currencies, making it the sixth institution in the country to offer Sharia-compliant products.
recent_events.impact: Diversified product offering; tapped Kyrgyz Islamic-finance market that grew 50.2% YoY to 13.6 bln KGS in H1 2025.

recent_events.title: Vyacheslav Kim completed acquisition of Alatau City Bank (formerly Jusan Bank)
recent_events.description: Kaspi.kz co-founder Vyacheslav Kim acquired 100% of Alatau City Bank JSC — the parent of Optima Bank — making him the ultimate beneficial owner of Optima Bank.
recent_events.impact: Changed control of one of Kyrgyzstan's largest banks to a Kazakh fintech billionaire.

recent_events.title: Optima Bank supported BIFF-2025 (Bishkek International Finance Forum)
recent_events.description: Optima Bank was one of nine Kyrgyz banks partnering with BIFF-2025, the leading financial forum in Central Asia, which gathered 400+ participants from 10 countries at Novotel Bishkek City Center.
recent_events.impact: Reinforced position among the country's top-tier banks and deepened international cooperation dialogue.

recent_events.title: Anuar Kuandikov elected Chairman of the Board of Directors
recent_events.description: Jusan Bank veteran Anuar Kuandikov replaced Yermek Arginov as Chairman of the Board of Directors; he chairs the appointments, risk-management and audit committees.
recent_events.impact: Strengthened integration between Optima Bank and its Kazakhstan-based shareholder.

recent_events.title: Kyrgyz banks, including Optima, tightened restrictions on Russian transactions
recent_events.description: Amid fears of U.S. secondary sanctions, Kyrgyz banks tightened compliance on financial transactions with Russian companies. Optima Bank was identified by the NBKR as one of the four banks most used by dropper fraud networks, prompting enhanced AML measures.
recent_events.impact: Operational and reputational pressure; forced further investment in compliance and sanctions screening.

recent_events.title: Global Money Week 2025 financial-literacy initiatives
recent_events.description: Optima Bank ran a series of financial-literacy programmes supporting youth and financial education across Kyrgyzstan throughout Global Money Week.
recent_events.impact: Brand-building and CSR positioning; aligned with National Bank financial-inclusion agenda.

core_business: Optima Bank is one of the largest commercial banks in Kyrgyzstan, ranked #6 by assets (~68 bln KGS as of December 2024). The bank provides a full range of retail and corporate banking services: Visa and Elkart payment cards, consumer and mortgage lending, retail and corporate deposits, money transfers (incl. MoneyGram), SWIFT transactions with European correspondent banks, digital banking (Optima24 mobile app and Optima Business B2B platform), and since August 2025 a Sharia-compliant Islamic finance window. The bank serves over 700,000 clients through a network of 60+ branches across the country, with ~1,600 employees.
apec_stance: Kyrgyzstan is not an APEC member economy, so Optima Bank has no direct APEC policy stance. However, the bank is deeply integrated into the Central Asian financial ecosystem and cooperates with international partners on multiple fronts: (1) it has been a recurring partner of the Bishkek International Finance Forum (BIFF), the leading regional forum that brings together banks, international organisations and regulators from 10+ countries; (2) its parent company Alatau City Bank (Kazakhstan) and ultimate beneficial owner Vyacheslav Kim (co-founder of Kaspi.kz) provide strategic access to the Kazakh and broader Central Asian markets; (3) the bank maintains stable European correspondent-bank relationships (notably via German banks) for SWIFT/USD transactions; (4) its executives have participated in IFC and USAID-backed risk-management training. The bank's main international priorities are digital transformation, attracting foreign capital into Kyrgyzstan, and expanding Islamic finance — areas where ADB, IFC and EBRD programmes are active in the region.
profile: Optima Bank OJSC (ОАО «Оптима Банк») is a Bishkek-headquartered open joint-stock commercial bank and one of the top-tier banks of Kyrgyzstan. Founded in 1993, the institution has gone through several rebrandings reflecting changes of ownership: it was originally established as Kyrgyzenergobank, renamed Energobank, became ATF Bank-Kyrgyzstan in December 2006 after acquisition by Kazakhstan's ATF Bank, was rebranded UniCredit Bank in June 2010 following UniCredit's acquisition of ATF Bank, and finally renamed Optima Bank in September 2013 after local management-led acquisition. Today the bank's majority shareholder (97.14%) is Kazakhstan's Alatau City Bank JSC (formerly First Heartland Jusan Bank), whose ultimate owner since July 2025 is Kaspi.kz co-founder Vyacheslav Kim — the largest single foreign investment in Kyrgyzstan's banking sector in recent years. Under the chairmanship of Beibut Kapyshev (Management Board) and Anuar Kuandikov (Board of Directors), the bank earned a record net profit of 2.56 bln KGS in 2025, all of which was retained to fuel further growth. The bank received an Islamic-finance licence from the NBKR in August 2025 and continues to expand its digital banking footprint (Optima24, Optima Business).
